patterns.name: rails-params-in-query
patterns.reason: Request input written into a query string reaches the database unchecked, so a request can change the query.
patterns.fix: Pass the value as a bound parameter or a hash condition instead of interpolating it.

patterns.name: rails-params-in-command
patterns.reason: Request input written into a shell command lets a request run commands of its own on the server.
patterns.fix: Pass the command and each argument separately, so no shell reads the input.

patterns.name: rails-params-in-path
patterns.reason: Request input in a file path lets a request read or write a file outside the folder meant for it.
patterns.fix: Look the file up from a record or an allowed list of names, and never build its path from the request.

patterns.name: rails-unescaped-output
patterns.reason: Output marked safe is sent to the browser without escaping, so any markup in it runs on the page.
patterns.fix: Let the view escape the value, or pass it through sanitize when some markup has to stay.
